answer:

Evidence: Apple's September 7, 2022 announcement, “Apple announces the next generation of AirPods Pro,” states both versions and prices in its “Pricing and Availability” section: https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2022/09/apple-announces-the-next-generation-of-airpods-pro/
